title: Correction, ongoing constraint, and an explicit return visit

input.original_instruction: Turn left, sorry, turn right, and walk to the blue door next to the stairs. Go through it into the lounge. Keep the sofa on your left as you cross the lounge and stop beside the window. Then return through the same blue door and stop beside the stairs.

subtasks: Turn right and walk to the blue door next to the stairs, then go through that door into the lounge.
